notes:
{根幹|こんかん} combines {根|こん} (root) + {幹|かん} (trunk), referring to the essential foundation or core of something.

Common expressions:
- {根幹|こんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成|な}す (to form the basis of)
- {根幹|こんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かか}わる→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧ (to concern the fundamentals)
- {根幹|こんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}るがす→揺るがす：12936_yurugasu⟧ (to shake the foundations)
- {根幹|こんかん}⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ (core part)

Used in formal or written contexts when discussing fundamental aspects of systems, organizations, or concepts.

- ⟦{根本|こんぽん}→根本：13107_konpon⟧ (root, fundamental - slightly more common)
